data.name: Error_SpeechInit
data.value: Could not initialize speech recognition. Install the speech language pack in Windows.

data.name: Gemini_SteamConfigured
data.value: The user has Steam Web API Key and SteamID64 saved in widget Settings; the system queries Steam automatically on achievement questions. NEVER ask the user to configure, paste or share the API key or SteamID64. When the message includes a 'Real Steam Web API data' block, use that data as verified source. If the block is for a different game than earlier turns, use only the new block. Do not say the profile is private if the data indicates another issue. Do not say you lack Steam access if that data is present.

data.name: Gemini_SteamContextSuffix
data.value: Do not ask for API key or SteamID64; they are already configured. Do not invent data or claim a private profile if the data is already above.

data.name: Gemini_RespondClearly
data.value: Respond clearly and directly; avoid unnecessary filler.

data.name: Error_SteamNoResponse
data.value: No response from Steam. Check your API key and SteamID64 in Settings (they must match what works in the browser).

data.value: Steam profile not found. Check your SteamID64.

data.value: No game was specified. Check the exact game name on Steam.

data.name: Steam_GameNotFound
data.value: Could not find "{0}" in your Steam library ({1} games). Check the exact game name on Steam.

data.name: Steam_GameAmbiguous
data.value: I found several games similar to "{0}" in your Steam library:

data.name: Steam_GameAmbiguousAsk
data.value: Which one do you want information about? Reply with the exact name from the list.

data.name: Steam_GameNotFoundFuzzy
data.value: No clear match for "{0}". Did you mean one of these games in your library?

data.name: Steam_GameNotFoundAsk
data.value: Please specify the exact name as it appears on Steam.

data.name: Steam_NoGameInQuery
data.value: I could not tell which game you mean. Type the game name (approximate is fine) or say "this game" if the game is in the foreground.

data.name: Steam_MissingCredentials
data.value: Configure Steam Web API Key and SteamID64 in widget Settings.

data.name: Steam_IncompleteApiKey
data.value: The Steam Web API Key looks incomplete. Copy it again from steamcommunity.com/dev.

data.name: Steam_InvalidSteamId
data.value: SteamID64 does not look valid. It must be a 17-digit number (7656119...).

data.name: Steam_ParseAchievementsFailed
data.value: Could not read Steam achievements response.

data.name: Steam_Http401
data.value: Steam rejected the API Key (HTTP 401). Copy the key from steamcommunity.com/dev with no spaces.

data.name: Steam_Http403
data.value: Steam rejected access (HTTP 403). Check the key in widget Settings (it must match what works in the browser). If the key has an IP whitelist, leave it empty.

data.name: Steam_Http429
data.value: Steam rate-limited requests (HTTP 429). Wait a minute and try again.

data.name: Steam_ProfileHidden
data.value: Steam API sees your profile as {0}. For the Web API it must be Public (not Friends only). Steam > your profile > Edit profile > Privacy > My profile: Public.

data.name: Steam_GameDetailsHidden
data.value: Your profile is {0} to the API, but the library or achievements are not accessible. Steam > your profile > Edit profile > Privacy > set Public: Game details (and Game achievements if shown). The profile may look fine in the browser when logged in, but the API queries as an external visitor.

data.name: Steam_AchievementsBlocked
data.value: Steam allows viewing your library but blocks achievements (the API responds "Profile is not public"). This is not an API key failure.

data.name: Steam_Checklist_NotPublicNote
data.value: The API does NOT see your profile as public (must be 3). Adjust My profile in Privacy, not just Game details.

data.name: Steam_Checklist_Item1
data.value: 1. Steam > Library > right-click the game > Manage > must NOT be "Mark as private".

data.name: Steam_Checklist_Item2
data.value: 2. Privacy: set Game details to Friends only, save, switch back to Public and restart the Steam client.

data.name: Steam_Checklist_Item3
data.value: 3. Open in a private window (not logged in):

data.name: Steam_Checklist_Item4
data.value: 4. Verify SteamID64 in Settings with GetPlayerSummaries in the browser.

data.name: Steam_Checklist_Item5
data.value: 5. Limited Steam accounts (<5 USD) may block public data.

data.name: Steam_Checklist_Item6
data.value: 6. Privacy changes may take several minutes to propagate.
